notes.text:
- Added location groups for each song, allowing you to easily exclude locations related to a specific song. Keep in mind that playing with a Cassette Tape goal will always place Cassette Tapes into each song's clear location, regardless of their excluded status.
- Fixed a logic error in which the "Event: Tuning!" location did not correctly require the "Photo of the Villa" item.

For instructions, see the [Setup Guide.](https://github.com/dannybonz/k-on_archipelago/blob/main/docs/setup.md)
